content:
The **Perfect Storm** is a submachine gun in *Fallout 76*.

The Perfect Storm is a 10mm Submachine Gun that uses the Incendiary legendary effect, which deals fire damage over time. When obtained, the Perfect Storm is leveled to the player's character - a level 10 character will receive a level 10 copy.
